text: new -d: validate dependencies before creating and committing the issue

Fixed on worktree branch: create_issue(deps=...) validates each dep exists before any write (a fresh issue cannot form a cycle), writes deps into the JSON, and appends 'created' then 'dependency <ids>' events in one commit, matching what set_dependencies records. cmd_new no longer calls set_dependencies. Tests: test_create_with_deps_is_one_commit_with_dependency_event, test_create_with_missing_dep_creates_nothing. scripts/dev/check all green, 163 tests.
